WHAT_THESE_NUMBERS_ARE_NOT: A completion percentage against the original plan is a bookkeeping figure. It does not measure the quality, novelty or correctness of the work, and it must not be quoted as if it did. Several items scored below 1.0 because the plan was deliberately departed from in favour of a stronger design, and at least one item scored 1.0 for a protocol that was reduced in scale.
